scenes.title: Key ideas
items: Pay out a share of expected income, not headline (e.g. 70%).
Retain the rest as a loss buffer; it absorbs the losses you assumed in 13.2.
Pay from the T0/T1 ladder (Module 12.4), refilled by income, so payouts never depend on…
Never pay from principal. If income falls short, the payout falls.
scenes.vo: Pay out a share of expected income, not headline (for example 70%). Retain the rest as a loss buffer; it absorbs the losses you assumed in 13.2. Pay from the T0/T1 ladder (Module 12.4), refilled by income, so payouts never depend on selling anything that day. Never pay from principal. If income falls short, the payout falls. Review quarterly: if realised income is below expected for two quarters, cut the payout to 70% of the new realised level.
